data.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement `plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh` that runs 7 verifications from sc-10 against the deployed stack, reading resource names from `review_telemetry.*` in `.claude/dso-config.conf`: (1) Lambda Function URL exists, (2) IAM role exists with correct trust policy, (3) S3 head-bucket succeeds, (4) S3 encryption configured, (5) S3 lifecycle rule present (90d → Glacier IR), (6) Lambda→S3 IAM `simulate-principal-policy` returns `EvalDecision=allowed`, (7) end-to-end healthcheck (POST 2xx and object visible in S3 within 60s). Script exits 0 only when all 7 pass; exits non-zero with per-check status when any fail.
**Why**: sc-10 is the explicit closure gate for the d2f9 sprint. This script is the mechanical check the completion-verifier references.
**Scope**:
- IN: Verification script with 7 checks, per-check status reporting, config-key validation.
- OUT: Building the AWS resources (provisioning stories). Live self-use review emission (separate story).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `aws-verify-live.sh` runs 7 distinct checks consuming `review_telemetry.*` keys from `dso-config.conf`: Lambda Function URL exists, IAM role exists, S3 head-bucket succeeds, S3 encryption configured, S3 lifecycle rule present, `iam simulate-principal-policy` for Lambda→s3:PutObject returns `EvalDecision=allowed`, and end-to-end POST returns 2xx with the object visible in S3 within 60s.
  ← Satisfies: sc-10  (sc-10: "7-command live AWS verification passes before d2f9 sprint closes")
- When this story is complete, all 7 checks passing causes `aws-verify-live.sh` to exit 0; any failing check causes it to exit non-zero and print a per-check status report naming the failing check.
  ← Satisfies: sc-10
- When this story is complete, any missing `review_telemetry.*` config key causes `aws-verify-live.sh` to exit 1 with a message naming the missing key.
  ← Satisfies: sc-10
- When this story is complete, after `aws-teardown.sh` runs, `aws-verify-live.sh` exits non-zero with per-check status indicating resources absent, and the end-to-end POST check times out within 5 seconds (not hung indefinitely).
  ← Satisfies: sc-10

## Considerations

- [Closure gate] This script is the mechanical check d2f9 sprint closure references; its exit code is load-bearing.
- [Simulate-principal-policy] Use `aws iam simulate-principal-policy` with the Lambda execution role ARN and `s3:PutObject` on the bucket ARN; assert `EvalDecision=allowed`.
- [Timing] The end-to-end healthcheck's 60s budget accommodates Lambda cold-start; use a poll-with-backoff loop, not a single shot.
- [Post-teardown safety] Script must detect and report absent resources quickly (≤5s for DNS timeout) rather than hanging.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a sprint operator, I want a 7-command live AWS verification script consuming review_telemetry.* config keys to gate sprint closure, so that infrastructure correctness is proven before the d2f9 epic closes.
